Feels Like Summer

Olivia Daye has a point to prove. Determined to follow her dream of creating a drinks brand to honour her late grandfather, she’s hoping her protein cocktails will be on the lips of all the tourists in Corfu this summer. There’s just one big meeting in Athens to go. But spurred on by her best friend, Avril, one last minute Tinder match ends in Leo…

Cretan Leonidas Dukakis is completing his military service in the Greek capital after the devastating loss of his brother. But when he meets Liv for no-strings fun and drinks her cocktails, an idea starts to form. With his family in crisis, he needs to take a chance, but will his decisions lead to only one destination - a summer of very heated rivalry?

Feels Like Summer

Pre-order
Winter With You

Thirty-something Gabriella Felix and her niece Phoebe are heading to New York for a trip to remember! Gabriella is promoting her lifestyle book, Zero Fucks Given and she needs to wow readers on this side of the Atlantic to ensure there are more books to come, but will the services of a stylist see her dressed for the success she needs?

Luca Manning is a stylist at the top of his game, but he's also hiding a big secret and when he meets Gabriella there's more than a mutual connection, it's like she can see right to the heart of him. And just maybe that's because she's hiding secrets of her own...

Summer Ever After

Forty-year-old Faye Lawson is falling back in love with life. Divorced from her cheating husband, she has turned her back on the UK and has been living the Greek dream in Corfu. Ex-pro basketballer Kostas Petsas has never met any woman like Faye before and, when conflict starts to surface, it seems they can’t see eye-to-eye on anything. Or perhaps, when things get body-to-body, both of them begin to wonder if it can turn into heart-to-heart.

Summer Ever After

Meet Me under the Northern Lights

When career-focused Chloe Bellamy is sent to Iceland on a last-minute work trip, it’s her big chance to prove she deserves a seat at the top. Gunnar Eriksson has a habit of saving people. First, when he rescued a young boy from a volcano. Neither of them are looking for love, but could one kiss beneath the Northern Lights change everything?

Meet Me under the Northern Lights

A Greek Island Gift

When Molly Adams finds out she’s inherited an apartment in Kassiopi, Corfu, she’s left thinking there must be some mistake. She doesn’t know anyone in Greece at all.

But when she arrives there’s a shock. Molly hasn’t inherited a whole apartment, it’s only 50%. But there’s more - she’s also inherited 50% of a boat, 50% of an olive tree and… 25% of a cat.
